blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) has imposed a temporary ban on poultry imports from Minnesota in the United States after the American state reported confirmed cases of bird flu. The import restriction covers domestic and wild birds and their products, including poultry meat, day-old chicks, eggs, and semen, according to the DA’s Department Circular No. 55.
